name: Role-trust family selected on a statement carrying a Resource -> UNSUPPORTED_TRUST_RESOURCE
note: IAM-1001 suite-3 test 68. A trust policy applies to the role it is attached to and has no Resource element. With Role trust explicitly selected, a Resource is a trust-policy syntax error: block with UNSUPPORTED_TRUST_RESOURCE at the Resource path; the supplied Resource must not become a second role target.
